info.name: UC2 IBM Verify Setup - MCP Agent
info.description:
Copyright IBM Corp. All Rights Reserved.

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

Follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md. Find the AgentID in the agent details. Configure the Token Exchange application entitlements and associate it under Agent tasks → Act on behalf of a user. Run suspension and delete requests only for the optional negative tests.

Start with docs/setup.md. Use this collection as an alternative to cURL for API steps. Local STS_* environment keys contain the Token Exchange application settings; retain those key names.

request.description:
Purpose: Authenticate setup operations with the administrative API client.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; copy access_token to admin_access_token. If 401, check this client ID/secret. After entitlement changes obtain a fresh token.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const v = pm.response.json().access_token; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("admin_access_token", v); }

request.description:
Purpose: Create the governed identity before associating runtime credentials.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 201; copy id to agent_id. Expected name: UC2 Course MCP Conversational Agent. Reuse an existing record instead of creating duplicates.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const v = pm.response.json().id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("agent_id", v); }

request.description:
Purpose: Create the OAuth application supplying runtime credentials.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 201; copy client_id and client_secret to actor_client_id and actor_client_secret. This client_id is not the AgentID.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const v = pm.response.json(); if (v.client_id) pm.collectionVariables.set("actor_client_id", v.client_id); if (v.client_secret) pm.collectionVariables.set("actor_client_secret", v.client_secret); }

request.description:
Purpose: Read the specific created agent and inspect lifecycle and credential association.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; id must equal agent_id. Repeat after activation/suspension. Verify application association in the console.

Purpose: Bind the runtime application to the registry AgentID and mark its purpose.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 204 with no body. actor_application_id is the application management ID. Requires manageAppAccessAdmin. Replaces tags: preserve other tags on customized applications. Verify association in Identity & authentication.

Setup: in the Token Exchange application select All users are entitled to this application for the tutorial. In the agent’s Agent tasks select Act on behalf of a user, associate UC2 Course MCP Agent Token Exchange, and save. See docs/audit.md for list/enrollment audit examples.

request.description:

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; rerun 04 and confirm ACTIVE and association. Obtain a fresh actor token. Preserve customized metadata when adapting lifecycle PUT.

request.description:
Purpose: Optional negative test: suspend the agent and test a fresh runtime request.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; rerun 04. Record the actual denial stage in a new token request. Reactivate with 06. Previously issued JWTs may remain usable until expiry.

Purpose: Authenticate the runtime OAuth application to obtain an actor token representing the registered agent.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; copy access_token to actor_access_token; run 10. actor sub must be the registry agent_id, not actor_client_id.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const v = pm.response.json().access_token; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("actor_access_token", v); }

request.description:
Purpose: Optional setup: register the authorization-details schema accepted by Verify.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 201. If type exists, inspect/update via console; do not duplicate it or remove UC1 fields. See payloads/mcp_tool_action_adt_schema.json.

Purpose: Verify actual actor identity before configuring delegation or calling tools.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; active=true, sub=agent_id, client_id=actor_client_id. Use a client authorized to introspect this token (resource_client_id/secret; your Token Exchange client may be permitted). Configure subject may_act.sub=agent_id, keep human sub unchanged.
